record.category: government filings API (filer submissions, XBRL company facts, bulk archives)

free_tier.stated: Free data.sec.gov JSON APIs with no authentication or key; maximum request rate 10 requests per second; automated tools must declare a User-Agent; nightly bulk ZIP archives of all the JSON
free_tier.notes: The submissions API and XBRL data update through the day as filings are disseminated. The www.sec.gov documentation pages answered HTTP 403 to an automated page fetch with no declared agent. A keyless submissions call with a generic probe agent answered HTTP 200.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated; one JSON per filer, and companyfacts.zip and submissions.zip hold every filer

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the 10 requests per second rate bounds a client

record.tooling: curl or any HTTP client that sends a declared User-Agent
record.chaining: Company filings and XBRL facts for free; the nightly ZIPs replace thousands of calls and feed a database load.
record.limits_note: Bulk path: companyfacts.zip and submissions.zip, rebuilt nightly at about 3:00 a.m. ET. Storage terms: no storage limit read; the page asks to download only what is needed.
record.binding_note: 10 requests per second is the only ceiling, and the bulk ZIPs avoid it.

identity_cost.detail: The APIs need no authentication or key; automated callers declare a User-Agent with a company name and contact address in the request header, which is not an account.

record.reliability_note: Requests above the rate, or from an undeclared automated tool, can be limited or refused; the www.sec.gov pages answered HTTP 403 to an automated fetch with no declared agent.
record.confidence_note: Rate, auth and bulk terms are read from SEC pages; a keyless submissions call answered 200.

evidence.proved: the APIs need no authentication or keys
evidence.quote: These APIs do not require any authentication or API keys to access.

evidence.proved: the bulk ZIP is republished nightly
evidence.quote: This ZIP file is updated and republished nightly at approximately 3:00 a.m. ET.

evidence.proved: bulk archives are the efficient route
evidence.quote: The most efficient means to fetch large amounts of API data is the bulk archive ZIP files, which are recompiled nightly.

automated callers declare a user agent

record.notes: Keyless, 10 requests per second, nightly bulk ZIPs. Storage terms: no limit read.
